name: Docker Compose
note: One file for the whole stack; the default for local multi-service apps.

name: Tilt
note: Live updates and a dashboard for many services; needs a Tiltfile.

name: Flisk
note: One command for the whole app on top of Docker and Tilt, with agent skills.

name: Kind
note: Kubernetes in Docker, for real cluster behaviour on a laptop.

name: Dev Containers
note: The editor's whole toolchain in a container.

name: Nix
note: Reproducible everything, at the cost of a steep start.

name: Garden
note: Graph of builds, tests and deploys across environments.

name: Vagrant
note: Whole VMs per project; mostly replaced by containers.

name: Okteto
note: Develop inside a remote cluster with file sync.
